title: Signature-Informed Transformer for Asset Allocation
claim: The standard forecast-then-optimize pipeline is flawed: missing inductive bias, mismatched objectives, and compounding errors yield poor decisions.
layout: Single rounded panel, left-to-right flow with return arrow; red numbered failure callouts
description: A single rounded-rectangle panel shows the conventional two-stage asset allocation workflow. On the left, a stock ticker list (TSLA, NVDA, AAPL, ...) feeds through a large light-green arrow into a neural-network icon labeled 'Forecasting Models'. A second green arrow labeled '±n% Error' leads to a gear/pie-chart icon with a tree of triangle, circle and square shapes, labeled 'MSE'. A red slashed arrow runs down to 'Portfolio Optimization', then a blue arrow loops back left to a dashed box 'Asset Allocation'. Three bold red callouts, '(1) Lacks Financial Inductive Bias', '(2) Objective Mismatch' and '(3) Error Amplification', have blue connector arrows pointing at the stages where each flaw arises. The eye goes first to the red labels and the big green arrows.
caption: A depiction of flawed strategies for asset allocation
abstract: Modern deep learning for asset allocation typically separates forecasting from optimization. We argue this creates a fundamental mismatch where minimizing prediction errors fails to yield robust portfolios. We propose the Signature Informed Transformer to address this by unifying feature extraction and decision making into a single policy. Our model employs path signatures to encode complex path dependencies and introduces a specialized attention mechanism that targets geometric asset relationships. By directly minimizing the Conditional Value at Risk we ensure the training objective aligns with financial goals. We prove that our attention module rigorously amplifies signature derived signals. Experiments across diverse equity universes show our approach significantly outperforms both traditional strategies and advanced forecasting baselines. The code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Signature-Informed-Transformer-For-Asset-Allocation-DB88
